evaluation.goal: Scan the input. Count only ASCII letters A-Z and a-z, starting from 1. For every third ASCII letter encountered, append a string consisting of its zero-based absolute input index, a colon, and the lowercase form of that letter. Ignore all other characters without counting them.

Scan the full input. Count only ASCII digits 0-9, starting from 1. For each even-numbered digit encountered, append its zero-based absolute input index followed by ':' and the digit itself. Ignore nondigits while counting digits.

Scan the input from left to right. For every '!' at index i > 0, append the single character immediately preceding that exclamation mark. If '!' is at index 0, emit nothing. Preserve duplicates and all character types.
